EC1: Patients with any contraindications [OR] or hypersensitivity [AND] related to antiplatelet therapy
EC2: Patients with Acute Myocardial Infarction (ST elevation myocardial infarction [OR], Non ST elevation myocardial infarction)
EC3: Patients who are anticipated to receive treatment [OR] or surgery [AND] that may require desisting the administration of antiplatelet therapy for 2 weeks or longer during the period of the clinical trial
EC4: Chronic total occlusion [OR] (CTO) lesions, in-stent restenosis (ISR)
EC6: Women who are breastfeeding, pregnant, or desiring pregnancy
EC8: Patients with a life expectancy of less than 1 year
EC9: Patients who have received a drug-eluting stent (DES) procedure within the past 6 months
EC10: Any other patients judged by the investigator to be unsuitable for the trial
